content.user_title: Design HIG Search and Navigation Controls
content.value_statement: Designers and app builders need precise Apple HIG guidance for search, page, and path controls. This skill turns the reference material into practical component recommendations and platform notes.
actual_capabilities: Recommend a search field, page control, or path control for a specific interface problem.
Summarize HIG best practices for search fields, scope controls, and tokens.
Explain page control behavior across iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS.
Describe macOS path control styles, placement, and platform support.
Identify clarifying questions about content type, platforms, dataset size, and search priority.
limitations: Covers only search fields, page controls, and path controls.
Summarizes included HIG guidance and does not replace current Apple documentation.
Does not generate production UI code or run accessibility validation.
Path control guidance is limited to macOS in the included reference.

use_cases.title: Choose Mobile Search Placement
use_cases.description: Compare tab bar, toolbar, and inline search options for an iOS app screen.

use_cases.title: Specify macOS Path Navigation
use_cases.description: Decide whether a standard or pop-up path control fits a file browsing workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Onboarding Pagination
use_cases.description: Check whether a page control fits a flat onboarding sequence and expected platform behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Pick the Right Component
prompt_templates.prompt: I am designing a screen for [platform]. The user needs to [search or navigate]. Recommend the best HIG component and explain why.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Search Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a search experience for [content type] on [platform]. Include placement, placeholder text, result behavior, and scope options.

prompt_templates.title: Review Page Control Usage
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page control pattern: [describe flow]. Check whether it fits HIG guidance, platform behavior, and indicator customization rules.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Cross-Platform Navigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare search fields, page controls, and path controls for [app concept] across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS.

output_examples.input: An iPhone app needs fast search across a large notes list.
output_examples.output: Use a search field with immediate results and helpful suggestions. Place it where users can reach it easily, then add scopes if categories are clear.

output_examples.input: A macOS document browser needs to show the selected folder hierarchy.
output_examples.output: Use a path control in the window body. Choose the standard style for visible hierarchy, or the pop-up style when space is limited.

output_examples.input: An onboarding flow has six peer screens and swipe navigation.
output_examples.output: A page control is appropriate because the screens form a flat ordered list. Keep indicators simple and avoid using many custom images.

best_practices: Provide the target platform, content type, and navigation goal before asking for recommendations.
Ask for both the component choice and the expected interaction behavior.
Validate final interface decisions against current Apple documentation and product constraints.
anti_patterns: Asking for generic navigation advice without naming the platform or content type.
Using a page control for hierarchical navigation or unrelated destinations.
Treating macOS path controls as available on every Apple platform.

faq.question: What components does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Apple HIG guidance for search fields, page controls, and path controls.

faq.question: Can it choose between search placements?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare tab bar, toolbar, sidebar, and inline search patterns when platform context is provided.

faq.question: Does it generate SwiftUI or UIKit code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on design guidance, behavior specifications, and platform differences.

faq.question: Is path control guidance available for iOS?
faq.answer: No. The included reference states that path controls are a macOS component.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this replace Apple Human Interface Guidelines?
faq.answer: No. Use it as a focused assistant, then verify important decisions with current Apple documentation.
